title: Add BIST OUCH dissector
description:
Adds a dissector for BIST OUCH (order entry) protocol.
- Registered in build system (CMakeLists.txt)
- Listed in Wireshark_Release_Notes.adoc
- SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
- Tested locally on Wireshark 4.4.8
- [sampletcp.pcap](/uploads/3f4ec466568b1a4a5882895fd534f56b/sampletcp.pcap)
